Commentary.Commentary: Right then! With the Women’s T20 World Cup right around the corner, another Warmup game comes to an end with Sri Lanka Women playing Bangladesh Women out in all the departments of the game and sealing a 30 run victory. The Warmup games move on its next phase as we have three games lined up on the 1st of October 2024. It will be South Africa Women versus India Women, England Women versus New Zealand Women, and Australia Women versus West Indies Women. All three games will begin at 2 pm GMT. You can always join us early as we bring you all the pre match excitement. Till then, have a good night!

In the end, Bangladesh Women outclassed Pakistan Women in all aspects of the game. The win not only restores Bangladesh's confidence but also sends a strong message as they look determined for the main tournament.

Bangladesh batted first and set a competitive target of 140 runs. They started well but stumbled after the loss of opener Shathi Rani, leading to a slowdown in scoring. However, a late flourish by Shorna Akter, who smashed a quickfire 28, helped Bangladesh post a solid total. Pakistan's bowlers made a concerted effort, utilizing eight different bowlers to keep the pressure on Bangladesh. Sadia Iqbal took two crucial wickets, while Omaima Sohail, Tuba Hassan, Diana Baig, and Nida Dar all chipped in with key contributions to restrict the Bangladeshi batting lineup. Chasing 140, Pakistan Women struggled to build partnerships, losing wickets at regular intervals and never managing to gain control of the game. Bangladesh’s disciplined bowling attack consistently put pressure on the Pakistan batters, who couldn't recover from the early blows. The Bangladesh bowlers outplayed their opponents, showcasing a well-rounded performance in both pace and spin.

Bangladesh Women have secured a convincing 24-run victory over Pakistan Women, bowling them out for just 117 runs in 18.4 overs. This win is a much-needed confidence booster for Bangladesh after their previous loss to Sri Lanka Women. Despite Pakistan’s promising start with the ball, they faltered in the latter stages of the game.
